d:
Yugapurushan is a 2010 film about the life and times of Sree Narayana Guru. The movie is directed by R. Sukumaran. It has an ensemble cast, led by Thalaivasal Vijay as Sree Naryana Guru.
Song : Oru Mathavumanya
Film : Yughapurushan
Singer : K J Yesudas
Music : Mohan Sithara
Lyricist : Kaithapram
